_comment: The market-tier checkpoint clerk (entity tier_clerk_market, pallass_market). The arrival QUALIFY beat: papers_for_pallass stage 3 -- the 2g entry stamp (compound {gold, accomplishment} gate). Race text_variants carry the city's profiling register (Human friction / Drake assumed-local; gnoll falls back to base -- the base line must stay load-bearing on its own). Forward-reference table: docs/design/pallass-staging/phase-c-forward-references.json. CLASS-FOUNDATION REVIEW WAVE (controller ruling, 2026-07-12): haggling is now OPT-IN game-wide (dialogue.gd's `_priced_gold` defaults to NO discount; only a `haggle: true` node ever discounts), so R5's earlier `no_haggle: true` flag here is REMOVED as redundant -- the entry stamp is a CIVIC fee, the posted-prices register's own load-bearing example (this file's own pre-existing comment on the stamp option below already cites it), and civic fees never carry `haggle`. The dedicated text_variant (gated on holding [Bargain], ordered LAST so it wins over the phase/race lines per the established 'later match wins, most-specific overrides' convention) stays: the clerk's own diegetic refusal line -- 'a clerk line when a Trader tries', the plan's own framing.

hub.speaker: Tier Clerk
hub.text: State your business and your sponsor.

text_variants.text: State your business. The tier doesn't sleep, and neither, apparently, do you.

text_variants._comment: Race-variant line set: Human friction (Pallass reads Human presence as rare/noticed, per docs/design/city-identity-bible.md). PLACEHOLDER copy, D-phase replaces.
text_variants.text: A Human, this far in. State your business and your sponsor -- twice, if the first answer doesn't hold up.

text_variants._comment: Race-variant line set: Drake assumed-local -- the clerk assumes a Drake PC belongs here without asking why. PLACEHOLDER copy, D-phase replaces.
text_variants.text: Papers, then, same as everyone through this gate. Sponsor's name, and don't waste my morning.

text_variants._comment: Class-foundation pass R5 (2026-07-12): the Pallass haggle-refusal's own diegetic line -- ordered LAST (wins over phase/race). Posted prices, no exceptions (mechanically the game-wide default since the review wave's opt-in inversion; this line is the civic register saying so out loud).
text_variants.text: Posted rate, same as everyone. I don't set the price and I don't move it, whatever they taught you to say back home.

options._comment: The arrival stamp itself -- gated on pallass_attuned (Stage 2, Krshia's stone) so the clerk only stamps someone the Door actually recognizes. 2g fee, posted-prices register (docs/design/city-identity-bible.md: 'prices are POSTED... no haggling'). Banks pallass_entry_stamped, THE producer forge_tier_permit's own beat 1 waits on.
options.text: Papers for Pallass, filed and attuned. (2 gold)

stamped.speaker: Tier Clerk
stamped.text: Stamped. Market tier, until you've got cause for more. Mind the queues.
